mappings.assertion: TestWriteUpdatePreferencesChannelBytes writes a typed preferences channel and asserts the exact persisted bytes and the typed round trip; TestUpdateChannelFlagOverridesEnv, TestUpdateChannelEnvOverridesSavedPreference, TestUpdateChannelStopsAtDoubleDash, TestUpdateChannelLastWins and TestDisableUpdateChecksPreservesSavedChannel keep selection precedence and saved-channel preservation over the Channel-typed Config, flag, environment and preference carriers.

TestValidateChannel, TestMaybeUpdateAndReexecInvalidChannelFatal, TestMaybeUpdateAndReexecInvalidEnvChannelFatal and TestLookupCandidateInvalidChannelReturnsFatalError refuse unknown flag, environment and Config channels with the unchanged FatalError message; TestUnknownSavedChannelLoadsThenIsRefused loads an unknown saved channel as today and refuses it at the same validation boundary with the same message.
TestOracleA2UpdateSettings (C-14) runs the settings-only flags and the preferences file live against unchanged goldens, fixtures, twins and PROVENANCE, together with the remaining oracles.
TestK4ImportDirectionGuard and TestS1SizeGuard run under make lint: the change adds no import edge, package or size offender.
